title: Prediction Markets Beat Social Media at Finding Truth, Says Vitalik Buterin
summary: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin defends prediction markets against moral criticism, arguing financial stakes create accountability absent in social media while critics question ethics of profiting from deaths.
